content: These references include research on topics such as breastfeeding's impact on lung function, childhood obesity, cognitive development, maternal health, cancer risk, and other health-related factors. The studies span a wide range of years and geographic locations, highlighting the global interest in understanding the shortand long-term benefits of breastfeeding. The references also include meta-analyses, cohort studies, and case-control studies, emphasizing the breadth of evidence supporting the role of breastfeeding in improving health outcomes.
